valuation_lane.valuation_commentary: At $62.99 current price, the frozen pack projects weighted fair value $37.34, -40.72%, and an extreme_overvalued band; score -1.0 is copied verbatim. The eligible primary through-cycle DCF anchor is $37.34 with sensitivity of $30.07–$48.35. Other live references diverge: owner earnings $16.20, analyst PT $67.75, and the relative family $56.85 (peer P/E $43.54; comps $70.16). Peer P/E and comps share one correlation group; analyst PT is external expectations rather than cash-flow evidence. Legacy DCF anchors are ineligible as superseded by the auditable DCF; forward earnings is ineligible while cash-flow intrinsic anchors are live; the forecaster blend is ineligible for low forecast confidence and transition without a safe model. I acknowledge the paradigm-only transition case but do not override the pack's cash-flow evidence; high-rate regime pressure is the dissent basis rather than rejection of the transition thesis.
